capabilities: Snapshot notes automatically at editing-session boundaries, including edits from external tools
Render a git-style inline diff of a note against a chosen baseline snapshot
Keep or revert individual diff hunks with per-hunk buttons
Navigate between pending hunks with a prev/next bar
Use core File Recovery snapshots as an additional snapshot source
extras: Reading File Recovery snapshots relies on that core plugin's internal IndexedDB structure, which an Obsidian update could break; the plugin's own automatic snapshots are unaffected. Snapshots stay in local IndexedDB with configurable retention (30 days default).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to review edits against a past state and accept or reject individual changes, which is tedious when AI tools or scripts rewrite notes.

relations.evidence: additionally uses snapshots from the core File Recovery plugin when available
the same approach as the Time Machine community plugin

summary: Git-style diff reviewer that snapshots notes automatically and lets you keep or revert each change hunk inside the editor.
